# RedRouter: Web Fetch

Requires `RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL` and, when the instance requires one, `RED_ROUTER_API_KEY`. See
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reddb-io/red-router/main/skills/red-router/SKILL.md for setup.

## Discover

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/models/web \
  | jq '.data[] | select(.type=="webFetch") | .id'
```

Web fetch entries in the model list end in `/fetch` (for example `<provider>/fetch`). Without
`provider` or `model`, RedRouter picks a configured provider and falls back to others on
retryable failures; an explicit provider never falls back.

## Endpoint

`POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/web/fetch`

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `url` | yes | an http or https URL |
| `provider` or `model` | no | a fetch provider from discovery; omit to auto-select |
| `format` | no | `markdown` (default), `text`, `html`, `links` or `screenshot` |
| `max_characters` | no | truncate the content; 0 (default) keeps everything |
| `depth` | no | link-follow depth, 0 (default), 1 or 2, where the provider supports it |
| `wait_for_selector` | no | CSS selector to wait for on JavaScript-heavy pages |
| `include_metadata` | no | include page metadata in the response |

## Example

```bash
curl -X POST $RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL/v1/web/fetch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_ROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url":"https://example.com","format":"markdown","max_characters":5000}'
```

JS:

```js
const r = await fetch(`${process.env.RED_ROUTER_BASE_URL}/v1/web/fetch`, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RED_ROUTER_API_KEY}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ url: "https://example.com", format: "markdown" }),
});
const page = await r.json();
console.log(page.metadata?.title, page.content.length);
```

## Response shape

```json
{
  "provider": "<provider-id>",
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "content": "# Example Domain ...",
  "links": [],
  "metadata": { "title": "Example Domain", "description": null, "truncated": false },
  "screenshot_url": null
}
```

`metadata.truncated` is `true` when `max_characters` cut the content.
